description: Scoring weights for grant matching, aligned with M300 debt-sensitivity principles

geography.rationale: Geography determines basic eligibility; important but not differentiating among eligible funders

thematic.rationale: Thematic fit is strongest predictor of funder interest; highest weight

size.rationale: Important for practicality but projects can be right-sized or phased

ownership.rationale: Critical for M300 alignment and debt-sensitivity; high weight

eligibility.rationale: Usually binary (eligible or not); lower weight for scoring variation

country_priority.condition: Project country explicitly listed as funder priority

country_in_region.condition: Project country within funder's regional scope

africa_wide_for_african_country.condition: Funder covers all of Africa, project in Africa

global_south_for_eligible_country.condition: Funder covers Global South, project in eligible country

adjacent_region.condition: Project country borders funder's focus region

not_covered.condition: Project country not in funder scope

primary_match.condition: Project type matches funder's primary focus

secondary_match.condition: Project type matches funder's secondary focus

cross_cutting_match.condition: Project has strong cross-cutting elements funder values

adjacent_match.condition: Project type is adjacent to funder's focus areas

weak_match.condition: Some thematic overlap but not strong alignment

within_range.condition: Project cost within funder's typical ticket size

within_50pct_boundary.condition: Project cost within 50% of range boundaries

within_100pct_boundary.condition: Project cost within 100% of range boundaries

far_outside.condition: Project cost significantly outside typical range

all_criteria_met.condition: All stated eligibility criteria clearly satisfied

examples: Instrument mismatch: project seeks grant-only, funder offers only loans
Sovereign debt risk: funder requires government guarantee for community project
Ownership conflict: funder requires private developer for community-owned project
Partial geography fit: country not explicitly listed
Size stretch: project cost significantly outside range
Missing eligibility: one key criterion unclear
Timing mismatch: funder's call may not align
Documentation gaps: some required documents not yet available
Governance questions: ownership structure needs clarification
Technical uncertainty: technology not in funder's common portfolio
Capacity concerns: implementing entity may need support

debt_sensitivity_modifiers.description: Additional scoring adjustments based on M300 debt-sensitivity principles

tier_2_minimal_debt.description: Slight reduction for bridge financing risk

tier_4_high_debt.description: Major reduction - generally excluded for community projects

final_score_calculation.description: Funders scoring below threshold are excluded from results

tie_breaking_rules.rule: Prefer grant over results_based_grant over blended
tie_breaking_rules.rationale: Minimizes debt exposure and bridge financing risk
